title: Why Did Jesus Sleep In The Storm?

bible.text: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, "Quiet! Be still!" Then the wind died down and it was completely calm. He said to his disciples, "Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?"

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why were You sleeping while they were fighting the storm? 😟

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: They were fishermen. They knew the boat. They knew the water. Maybe they thought they could handle it themselves.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They had experience. They knew what they were doing. But experience can make a person feel like they are in control.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So maybe they thought... Jesus is tired. They can take care of the boat.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Perhaps. But when the storm became bigger than their experience, they discovered something their knowledge could not fix.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: And that's when they woke You up.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Yes. And when I calmed the storm, I asked them, "Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?"

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So their problem wasn't that they were fishermen... it was that they trusted what they knew more than the One who was with them.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Exactly. Experience is valuable. Knowledge is valuable. But neither should take the place of faith in Me. 🤍

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Sometimes the storm reveals what you've been trusting. When your own strength reaches its limit, remember who is still in the boat.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever trusted your own strength more than God? 🌊 Leave a 🙏 if this reminded you to trust Him again.
